label: WEAKLY_VERIFIABLE_2: WeaklyVerifiable1936 F s: for some further premises ps and observation…
definition: `WeaklyVerifiable1936 F s`: for some further premises ps and observation statement e, s together with ps entails e and ps alone does not entail e. The further premises are unrestricted.
note: Variant V2. Types Ayer's first-edition formulation in claim AYER-LTL-PELICAN-I-20-CRITERION (ch. I, p. 20 of the Pelican reprint), which Ayer's own note calls over-simplified.
